scope: Reviewed native component purpose and actual published desktop captures across A-L, including 16 source repairs. Mobile measurements and behavior verification are separate evidence.

requiredComponents.label: Navigation
requiredComponents.contract: Visible logo and usable primary navigation. Compare common destinations and mobile-menu behavior; record shared designs explicitly.

requiredComponents.label: Hero
requiredComponents.contract: Recognizable primary page introduction with a deliberate visual identity. Compare the same movie/campaign content when styling.

requiredComponents.label: Food & Drink
requiredComponents.contract: Dedicated native Concessions Menu using the same actual site catalog, with section heading and variant-specific styling.

requiredComponents.label: Private Parties
requiredComponents.contract: Dedicated private-hire content that identifies occasions or use cases and links to the verified private-hire route. Public programme content alone does not qualify.

requiredComponents.label: Membership
requiredComponents.contract: Dedicated membership introduction, meaningful details or next-step guidance, and an explicit link to the actual membership route. A mailing-list signpost alone is partial.

requiredComponents.label: Contact Us
requiredComponents.contract: Native Generic Form with name/email/message and visible send action. Preserve actual configured handling; never invent notification recipients.

statusDefinitions.present: Dedicated visible source treatment exists. This does not certify behavior, visual completeness or production readiness.
statusDefinitions.partial: Related source content exists but does not meet the component purpose fully.
statusDefinitions.missing: No dedicated equivalent in the captured page.
statusDefinitions.notRendered: Source section is declared but captured height is0. Rendering cause is unverified.
